split.policy: deterministic chemistry-coverage holdout within training descriptor ranges
split.coverage_source: optimized clean structures and retained eligible site labels
split.geometry_policy: preserve every source data-quality exclusion; verify selected OH/O/OOH endpoints before split
split.bounds_scope: all nine descriptors globally; metal charge/spin also conditioned on metal identity and site role
split.geometric_domain_note: coordinatewise descriptor ranges, not a guarantee of multivariate convex-hull inclusion
split.selection_order: new adsorption metals; new ligand environments; one structure per pair; environment balance; nearest matching training sites; name tie break
split.outer_folds: three repeats of five grouped folds generated from the shared training names
split.validation_status: deliberately interpolation-focused chemistry coverage; not a random population estimate or untouched external test
